Debt management. A 2014 Debt Management Performance Assessment has

revealed modest improvements over the previous (2010) Assessment, linked to the setting

up of the Treasury Single Account and the operation of the General Ledger Custody

module, which provides delivery versus payment settlement and secure records of all

holders of government securities. However, important shortcomings remain, including

weak coordination with fiscal policy and low in-house analytical capacity to carry out debt

sustainability analysis.
